description: This Java class defines an event for the loan refund pre-processing phase within the Fineract project. It extends LoanBusinessEvent and specifies the event type 'LoanRefundPreBusinessEvent'.

classes.name: LoanRefundPreBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a 'pre' event triggered before processing a loan refund, indicating that recovery or validation steps might be taken prior to the actual refund transaction.

methods.name: LoanRefundPreBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a Loan object.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of this event, which is 'LoanRefundPreBusinessEvent'.
